dialogue.text: Do you have any plans for the weekend?
dialogue.translation: Ozali na bosɔkɔ nini mpo na week-end?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I think I want to go to the beach, but maybe it will be too crowded.
dialogue.translation: Nakolinga nalinga kɔ na plaj, kasi mbala mosusu ekɔ mpenza na bato mingi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Good idea! But do you have time to go with me?
dialogue.translation: Molɔngɔ malamu! Kasi, ozali na ntango mpo na kɔ na ngai?

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Perfect! I think it will be a good weekend.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hello, I bought this phone here, but it doesn't work.
dialogue.translation: Mbɔtɛ, nakí telephɔnɛ ya mɔkɔ kaka o kɔ́lɔngɔ́, kasi azali kosalema te.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I'm sorry about that. How long ago did you buy it?
dialogue.translation: Nalɛmbetɛ kɔ́ mɔ́kɔ. Nánti lokola mɛ́si ozwaki kɔ́la yango?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Only two days ago. I want a new one, if possible.
dialogue.translation: Sɔ́ libɔ́lɔ. Nakɔ́ta mɔkɔ mɔ́sɔ, soki ezali pɔ́na.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course. Take this form and fill it out. After that, I can give you a replacement.
dialogue.translation: Ya sóló. Kɔ́la fɔrmulɛrɛ ya mɔkɔ o, epɛ́i tozwaki kobɔngola yango, simá nákɔ́la ngá replacement.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thank you. So I give you the faulty phone back, and I get a new one?
dialogue.translation: Natɔndɔ́ bɔ́kɔ. Kɔ́mƐ́sá nakɔ́mɛlɛ́ yo telephɔnɛ ya mabe, mɛ́sɔ nakɔ́kɛ́tɛ ya mɔkɔ?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Exactly. And if you need more help, just ask me.
dialogue.translation: Ya sólo. Soki ozali na bɔ́kɔ ya sokó, zwá mɛ́.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Great. Can I have your name for the reservation?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, it's under the name García.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hello, I need to change my reservation for a different day.
dialogue.translation: Mbote, náswfu kobongisa réservation náyangó mpo na mokolo mosusu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course. Do you want to come earlier or later?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Later, please. Is a room available for next week?
dialogue.translation: Ntango ya zomi, bindé. Nsé ya motel ezali mpo na libósa ya mokolo oyo?

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.translation: Komema nákotalela. Topesi nsé ya motel mosusu ezali simá ya Lúne.

dialogue.speaker: A

dialogue.speaker: B

Motsala mpo na kozonga molóngi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Excuse me, I have a problem with my room. The TV doesn't turn on.
dialogue.translation: Ndimisá, názwi na problème na ndako wángo. Téléviseur eyeli kobanda.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Is it completely off?
dialogue.translation: Ndimisá mpo na kozonga yango. Ezali kitoko na ntina?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, I tried, but it doesn't work. I really don't understand why.
dialogue.translation: Eh, názui, kasi esili kozala. Malamu nákomona ntina nini.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Maybe there is a wrong connection. Let me check. I'll make it work soon.
dialogue.translation: Mbala mosúsu ezali lifuta ya mabé. Ndingá koluka. Nákosala kozala malamu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thank you. I haven't watched anything yet, so I hope you can fix it now.
dialogue.translation: Ndimisá. Nákomona yango kasi, kasi nákotosa kozala malamu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course. I'm sorry for the inconvenience. I'll check it right away.
dialogue.translation: Ya solo. Ndimisá mpo na lifuta. Nákota yango malamu.

scenario: Talking about a recent film or book
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Ezali na bokasi na film na program ya TV.
Comparatif ya 'good'.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I watched a new film last night. It was very good!
dialogue.translation: Nakɔta film mɔ́tɔ yango anso. Ezala malamu mingi!

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Oh really? What's the story about?
dialogue.translation: Ah, ndenge nini? Lokola nini mbotama?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: It's about a man who travels back in time. But the end is a bit strange.
dialogue.translation: Ezali ndenge mɔ́kɔ́tɔ ya mobali oyo akɔtaka lokolo na ntango. Kasi nsuka ezali mɛkɛtɛ mpenza.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That sounds interesting. I only read the book, not the film.
dialogue.translation: Ezali kokɔma mɛkɛtɛ. Nalingi sɔkɔ bukɛ, kasi film te.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: The film is better than the book, I think. But then I haven't read it.
dialogue.translation: Nakɔta film ezali malamu pɛpɛ kɔlɔ bukɛ, nayebaka. Kasi simá nazali kosala yango te.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: After I finish my exams, I'll watch it. Thanks for the recommendation!
dialogue.translation: Simá ya kokɛta mitindo na ngai, nakɔta yango. Matondo mpenza!

key_phrases.phrase: The end is a bit strange

scenario: At a job interview (basic)
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: ezali kozonga mokano ya mosala to ya bomoi
kombo oyo basali na likambo ya entrevue
yangela kombo
kobenga eloko oyo ndako
eloko oyo ekoki kozala
ezali kosalema na bosɔtɔ
kombo ya kozwa yango
mokolo oyo esili
eyambwisi makasi
kombo ya ntango

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Good morning. I have a few questions for you. First, why do you want this job?
dialogue.translation: Mbɔkɔ. Nazali na biso mpo na kozwa yo. Liboso, na nini ozali na bokasi ya mosala oyo?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I really like working with people, and I have some experience in customer service.
dialogue.translation: Nazali na bosɔtɔ kozala na mosala na bato, kasi nazali na mokano moke na mosala ya komonela bato.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I see. Also, can you work on weekends?
dialogue.translation: Nakoki kozwa. Kasi, okoki kozala na mosala na week-end?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, that is possible. I can work on Saturdays and Sundays.
dialogue.translation: Eh, ekoki kozala. Nakoki kozala na mosala na Samedi na Dimanche.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Good. When can you start?
dialogue.translation: Malamu. Sango okoki bandima?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I can start next week because I need to give notice at my current job.
dialogue.translation: Nakoki bandima liboso ya mokolo oyo ezali kozonga, soki nazali na bokasi ya kozua makasi na mosala na ngai oyo ezali kaka.

key_phrases.translation: Nazali na biso mpo na kozwa yo
Nazali na bosɔtɔ kozala na mosala
Nakoki bandima liboso ya mokolo oyo ezali kozonga

scenario: Discussing food preferences at dinner
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Verbo irregular: kola / kolaki / kolami
Motuna ya biloko nyonso oyo tokoli
Kotelama eloko oyo tolingi: Nalaki + motuna
Kotelama eloko oyo tolingi; mbala nyingi ezalaka na nsima ya verba ya infinitif
Esalemi na mibongo oyo ezali na biloko oyo epesami to epesami te
Motuna ya ndakisa to idée
Esalemi kopesa nguya na adjectif to verba
Na mokili oyo eleki kotuna 'nalongi' na nsima ya mibongo
Motuna ya kontra
Esalemi kopesa likambo oyo esili

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: What do you want to eat for dinner?
dialogue.translation: Olingi kola nini na lɛlɔ?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I like pasta, but I don't want anything heavy tonight.
dialogue.translation: Nalaki makolo, kasi lelo soyo nalingi eloko ya kozonga te.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: We have some chicken and vegetables in the fridge. That could be good.
dialogue.translation: Biso ezali na moko ya kɔlɔ́ngɔ́tɔ́ na bilɛmɛ na frigo. Eloko oyo ekoki kozala malamu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That sounds nice. But I really want something with more flavor.
dialogue.translation: Elobi malamu. Kasi na bosɔ́li nalingi eloko oyo ezali na mbɔsɔ na makasi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: How about we make a stir-fry with some rice?
dialogue.translation: Tɔ́kɔ́ mɛ́kɔ́ salisa moko ya riz?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, that's a good idea. So we can eat it together, and I can help you cook too.
dialogue.translation: Ɛɛ, idée ya malamu. Kɔ́mɔ́ tokoki kolala yango mobimbimo, mpe nalongi kosalisa yo kozonga lokola.

key_phrases.translation: eloko oyo ezali na mbɔsɔ na makasi

scenario: Asking for help with a computer issue
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Ezali na bosɔtɛ ya kosɛnga lisalisi na ntina malamu.
Verbo ya lokumu oyo ezali kosalema to kopesa lisalisi.
Ezali kobenga likambo to eloko oyo ezali na nguya.
Na contexte ya makasi to ordinateur.
Bosaleli ya souris.
Mboyo ya moniteur to appareil.
Eloko oyo tozali kopesa bosɔtɛ.
Opposé ya 'ya ngambo'.
Ezali kobenga kobimisa.
Ezali kobenga komona ntina to motif.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Could you help me? I need to use my computer, but the screen is black.
dialogue.translation: Ozali kozonga kosalisa ngai? Na mposa ya kosalela ordinateur na ngai, kasi écran ezali ya swɛlɛ.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sure. Let me see. Did you click the right button?
dialogue.translation: Eh. Komona ngai. Obɛngi kobɛnga bouton ya solo?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, I did. But it doesn't work. Maybe it's broken.
dialogue.translation: Eh, nalobi. Kasi esalaka te. Mbala mosusu ezali ya biloko.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Let's try again. Sometimes it works after a few minutes.
dialogue.translation: Tokobimisa kasi na mbula. Mbala mosusu esalaka sima ya minutes moke.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Okay, I will wait. But, because it's urgent, I need it now.
dialogue.translation: Malamu, nakotɛka. Kasi, na ntina ezali ya likambo ya bosɔtɛ, na mposa yango lelo.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I see. Let me check the power button. Ah, here! Now it works!
dialogue.translation: Nakoki komona. Komona ngai nabanda bouton ya nguya. Ah, wai! Lelo esalaka!

scenario: Renting an apartment (first inquiry)
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Motamboli yango na lokása ya 'rent an apartment' (kolá mbongo ya ngumba).
Na ameriki lisúsu; na angleterre bazali koyeba yango na nkombo ya 'flat'.
Motamboli yango na biso mpe na biloko oyo ezali na yango.
Ntango ya lokola; ezali na bosembo mpo na kosolola kolá ya mwa si mwa.
Motsala ya 'cost'.
Motamboli yango mpo na koyeba nini oyo ezali kobundimama na nzela.
Ezali kobundima mpe 'suelo', kasi kuna etági ya ngumba.
Ekɔmbo yango mpo na kozonga na kati.
Mpo na kozonga ntango moko mpe kati.
Ekɔmbo yango mpo na kozonga bosembo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hello, I want to rent an apartment. Is it available now?
dialogue.translation: Mbote, nakokola ngumba. Ezali na yango kaka?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, it is available. The rent is 800 dollars per month.
dialogue.translation: Eh, ezali na yango. Kolá ezali 800 dolares mwa si mwa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Does that price include water and electricity?
dialogue.translation: Nzela oyo ekobundisa mpe ya mái mpe ya liboso?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: No, it includes only water. Electricity is extra.
dialogue.translation: Te, ekobundisa kaka ya mái. Liboso ezali mosusu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: And what floor is it on? Is it near a supermarket?
dialogue.translation: Mpe ezali na etági nini? Ezali kɔtɔ na supermarché?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It's on the third floor, and it's between two big supermarkets. Maybe you can visit it tomorrow.
dialogue.translation: Ezali na etági ya zomi, mpe ezali kati na mitúngá míbalé míbi ya supermarché. Mbala mosusu tokoki kozala kuna mañana.
